selection_rule: Records whose screening_decision was full_text_needed at the start of this retrieval pass.
retrieval_constraint: Search for each report only through a complete symposium or annual proceedings manifestation. Do not use report-level manuscript, repository, author-copy, or purchase routes.

common_attempts.result: Crossref parent records and Curran Associates proceedings.com volume pages identified eight parent proceedings. The public Curran table-of-contents PDFs confirmed every target title and start page. The volume pages describe the complete manifestations as one to three softcover volumes and do not expose a complete digital volume.

The IAF Digital Library access policy states that full annual proceedings are a paid online offer. Publicly available IAF materials contain abstracts, programmes, and highlights rather than the complete proceedings.

Unpaywall classified all eight parent proceedings as closed. OpenAlex reported no repository full text for every parent proceedings DOI. OpenAIRE exposed only the DOI landing manifestations. Crossref supplied no full-text links.

Rendered Google searches by exact proceedings title, parent DOI/SKU, ISBN, PDF, download, e-book, annual proceedings, and ZIP found official catalog, contents, programme, abstract, citation, and report-level results, but no complete proceedings file. Exact-ISBN checks in Internet Archive and Open Library found no digital copy.
